## Objective

This notebook checks whether the two stimuli groups are matched on age, gender, and education.

```{r}
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(car)
library(knitr)
library(tibble)
```

```{r}
dir.create("../results", showWarnings = FALSE)

source("../sources/stat_helpers.R")
source("../sources/stimuli_manip_check.R")
```

```{r}
stimuli_info <- read_stimuli_participants("../data/stimuli_participants.csv")

stimuli_descriptives <- build_stimuli_descriptives(stimuli_info)
stimuli_manip_check <- build_stimuli_manip_check(stimuli_info)

print(stimuli_descriptives)
print(stimuli_manip_check)
```

```{r}
write_csv(stimuli_descriptives, "../results/stimuli_participants_descriptives.csv")
write_csv(stimuli_manip_check, "../results/stimuli_participants_manip_check.csv")
```
